}}'''Jheran''' is the [[clan chief]] of the [[Shaarad]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jheran|comp}}

==Appearance==
He is a slender man with graying brown hair.

==History==
He was a ''[[Sovin Nai]]'' before he was a clan chief. He is of the [[Haido]] sept.{{ref||comp}} 

He is married to [[Turolin]], his roofmistress.{{ref||comp}} 

His clan and [[Bael]]'s [[Goshien]] have had a [[Blood Feud]] for the last four-hundred years. The water at [[Chain Ridge Stand]] is a bone of contention between the two clans.

==Activities==
He is present at [[Alcair Dal]] when Rand al'Thor declares himself ''[[Car'a'carn]]'' at the same time as [[Couladin]].{{ref/book|4|57}} After this he takes his clan to [[Rhuidean]] while waiting for all the rest of the clans to gather there.{{ref/book|5|2}}

Due to Rand's ''[[ta'veren]]'' nature, Jheran and Bael heal the blood feud between their clans and swear water oaths to each other. He now seems very calm.

He leads his Aiel clan when he is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] when Rand gathers a massive army in preparation for the attack on [[Illian]].

Jheran is present during the signing of the [[Dragon's Peace]]. Rand originally leave the Aiel out of the document, but after [[Aviendha]] brings this up, it is amended. The Aiel are to become the neutral enforcers of the Dragon's Peace, settling any border dispute's are tracking down criminals across different nations as they see fit.
